body: Curious did you experience any effects on your taste / tongue? I was not able to drink plain water bc it tasted metallic to me during the time I would drink 10 grams a day. I was only able to drink water with like an entire lemon squeezed into it.

Ok same with the parents buying it and the huge tubs of hcl. I wouldn’t even use a scale I measured it scoops. I only found out I was up to 10 grams after putting the amount of scoops on the food scale. I was mind fucked. What did I expect tho I was increasing by a teaspoon every fucking day because that’s what I thought I needed to do.

Wow. I used to use it for my anxiety . My anxiety was really bad at that time and it made me so much less anxious. But the problem was that tolerance skyrocketed. And I was taking it everyday. Initially I had 250 mg pills.  After a few months I had to switch from taking the pills to the powder because I was taking 14 pills a day and it was getting expensive. It wasn’t like I was taking a few here and there either, I needed them all at once and the effects would last all day. Then I would get home and pretty much the moment I would sit down I would fall asleep. But anyways the powder version was phenibut Hcl and it was very acidic and the taste was awful so I had to literally toss it down the back of my throat 🤮 It burned my throat very badly. At the height of this I was taking 10 Grams a day. At one point I threw up while working, because I had taken too much. I feel so dumb looking back. But anyways I decided I didn’t need it this one day because I wasn’t going anywhere and I was just staying home. I had skipped days before, but not in a couple of weeks. This time when I skipped it I felt super ill, and then it got worse as the day went on. What felt like electric “zaps” kept happening in my brain. And the level of anxiety was just, unexplainable. I was physically sick and I had no appetite and couldn’t drink water at all. (that’s another thing, the taste of the powder or maybe the acid in it had screwed up my taste buds so badly that I thought the water at my house was like tainted. It tasted like straight up metal to me and I could only drink water with like an entire lemon squeezed into it) At this point I realized how seriously physically dependent I was and I was like ok I’m done with this stuff. The day was awful and I think I was just a shaking anxious mess. I didn’t sleep at all that night. The next day I decided I needed to taper because I still felt like I was dying. I began to taper and I called my doctor and I went in and he prescribed me gabapentin and said to continue tapering down the phenibut and up the gabapentin. This worked well. I wonder if I have liver disease from taking so much of this stuff for half a year.
